title: Deep neural network training method based on vectorgraphs for designing of metamaterial broadband polarization converters.
summary: Three transparent broadband polarization converters were fabricated and measured; their conversion spectra across 10–20 GHz agreed with the network-guided predictions. Two additional designs were simulation-only, so the evidence is limited to three prototypes.
ai_technology: A seven-layer deep neural network used vectorgraph-derived design features to guide metamaterial geometry for polarization-conversion spectra.
organization: School of Microelectronics (School of Integrated Circuits), Nanjing University of Science and Technology, Nanjing, China; Institute of Deep Perception Technology, Wuxi, China

evidence.tested: The study reports measured microwave conversion spectra for three fabricated prototypes; the two other designs were evaluated only in simulation.
evidence.unknown: Microwave-chamber measurements were compared with simulations for three prototypes. The tests do not establish generalization across materials or frequency ranges.
evidence.ai_role: The network-guided design produced three measured broadband polarization-converter prototypes with spectra agreeing with predictions.

source_review.scope: Primary Scientific Reports full text, including design, fabrication and measurement sections; publication date checked against primary metadata.
